_comment: PHP2Shell — Cloudflare WAF Custom Rules (import via dashboard or API)

rules.expression: (http.request.method eq "POST" and http.request.headers["content-type"] contains "multipart/form-data" and http.request.body.raw contains "PHP_SESSION_UPLOAD_PROGRESS")

rules.description: PHP2SHELL CVE-2026-109619 — Block PHP code in multipart upload
rules.expression: (http.request.method eq "POST" and http.request.headers["content-type"] contains "multipart/form-data" and (http.request.body.raw contains "<?php" or http.request.body.raw contains "<?="))

rules.description: PHP2SHELL CVE-2026-109618 — Block serialized PHP objects with pipe prefix
rules.expression: (http.request.method eq "POST" and http.request.body.raw contains "|O:" and http.request.uri.path contains ".php")

rules.description: PHP2SHELL CVE-2026-109618 — Block known POP gadget classes
rules.expression: (http.request.method eq "POST" and (http.request.body.raw contains "Monolog\\Handler" or http.request.body.raw contains "Guzzle\\" or http.request.body.raw contains "Illuminate\\Pending" or http.request.body.raw contains "Symfony\\Component\\Process"))

rules.description: PHP2SHELL — Block session file LFI attempts
rules.expression: (http.request.uri.query contains "/var/lib/php/sessions/sess_" or http.request.uri.query contains "/tmp/sess_" or http.request.body.raw contains "/var/lib/php/sessions/sess_")
